messages:
Rowan Bell: Quick alert — USW2 rack-3 started spilling egress to adjacent racks around 05:12 after maintenance reduced local headroom. Multiple tenants seeing p95 jumps.

Tara Singh: which tenants are hot? any dedicated slices?

Rowan Bell: tid-1577 (ml-eval), tid-6600 (partner), tid-3033 (internal load). Only tid-6600 has a small reserved slice; the rest are fractional. InfraBot created INC-13099 at 05:15.

InfraBot: ALERT rack-3: pool_gpu_util=0.88, nic_tx=1.4GB/s, cross_rack_egress=420MB/s, slab_evictions+290%. Incident ticket INC-13099 created.

Victor Nguyen: looks like regional maintenance removed 2 racks for preemptible drain, pushing warmups into rack-3. Our spillover heuristic usually prefers cross-rack but we hit headroom cap.

Marta Silva: short-term ops play: enable temporary egress-hedge lanes (ephemeral dedicated egress) to absorb bursts for 30m, and soft-fence the largest noisy tenant. We have a CLI:
```
hedgectl provision --rack=usw2-rack3 --type=egress-ephemeral --bandwidth_mb=400 --duration=30m --tag=spill-hedge
allocatorctl set-tenant-policy --tenant=tid-1577 --pool=ephemeral-hedge --egress_kbps=420000
```
That should reduce cross-rack traffic and buy time.

Tara Singh: curious about billing. Ephemeral lanes should be priced per MB/s-minute. Need to surface estimated cost when offering to customers. Also ensure we don't starve other racks.

Rowan Bell: agreed. For now, create ephemeral lane only if rack_headroom < 800MB and target impact < 20% on neighbor racks.

InfraBot: ACTION scheduled: provisioning ephemeral lane and soft-fence applied. Monitoring stream: https://telemetry.redwood/usw2/rack-3/INC-13099

(40s) InfraBot: ephemeral lane provisioned. tenant tid-1577 moved to pool ephemeral-hedge. egress for tenant limited.

Victor Nguyen: telemetry shows cross_rack_egress down 60%, p95 for neighbors improving. slab_evictions trending down but still elevated.

Marta Silva: next step: if slab_evictions > 250% for 10m after hedge, schedule live migrate to a reserved slice and send customer billing advisory. Also tag tenant for post-incident opt-in offer: "Auto-Hedge" feature.

Tara Singh: product note: Auto-Hedge should estimate cost delta and expected latency improvement. Add gating: only propose Auto-Hedge when regional spare capacity < 10% to avoid expensive cross-region moves.

Rowan Bell: ops runbook update: 1) detect spillover pattern (headroom drop + cross_rack_egress > 300MB/s), 2) attempt soft-fence + ephemeral lane, 3) monitor 10m, 4) if sustained, propose reserved carveout + migration window, 5) bill and tag.

InfraBot: NOTE automation task AUTO-2499 created to add Auto-Hedge suggestion flow and cost estimator.

Victor Nguyen: one edge-case: the ephemeral lane increases egress on the rack itself; ensure NIC shaping is applied per-lane not per-rack to avoid hitting old policers.

Marta Silva: good catch. We'll implement per-lane shapers and show predicted egress headroom change in the UI.

Tara Singh: also draft a short customer advisory: "If you see increased p95 during regional maintenance, consider Auto-Hedge or a short reserved slice. For sustained >400MB/s egress, reserved capacity recommended."

Rowan Bell: thanks, team. Closing after 30m stable and a brief postmortem. :white_check_mark:
